visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 current portable views, including the retained 1024×640 summary. The retained rectangular warm-stone hall has paired round-headed upper screens, pointed lower fields and recessed doors, broad blind arches, cornice brackets and two projecting portals. Twenty low roof domes sit on ochre shoulders; one is an opaque glazed abstraction. Two warm-stone minarets have open balconies and pale stacked-bulb caps. The close-view cap profile was refined after the first renders. All five occupied contact masks and footings include the hall, two tower pads and two portals. Fine inscriptions, exact ornament, public fountains, bazaar, adjacent roofs, landscaping, traffic, interiors and engineering are omitted. Deep footing faces in the coarse terrain view do not establish surveyed basement or retaining walls.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic-flat views, including the placement overlay. Five existing 256² graphs supply coursed stone walls, raw limestone trim/caps, weathered paving, standing-seam metal and bronze; six merged roles include local opaque glazing. Metric UVs and linear tints; no embedded images or unique atlas. Wall/trim graph roles were swapped after first inspection to give the hall coursed ashlar and smoother pale caps. Each shared graph is read once and eviction disposes model geometry. Precise subtraction uses only the current hall and associated projecting corner base. All 21 independent neighbors, including both mapped public fountain footprints, remain. The other minaret pad and portal projections are visual estimates. The flat overlay supports approximate pose/replacement, not surveyed terrain contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 27 current medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late light, street/block/skyline, silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. The twenty-bay dome grid, single glazed bay, rectangular hall and paired bulb-capped minarets remain legible. Skyline keeps all roof bays, coarse shoulders/domes and tower caps/balconies, and the two recessed portals. District adds paired upper fields, lower fields, blind-arch outlines, brackets and shoulder circles. Street restores more lower fields, coarse grids, dome ribs and more curved bulb profiles; closeup refines domes/ribs and caps. Far caps remain deliberately faceted. Whole cameras keep both towers; detail cameras crop other sections. Context buildings and terrain are illustrative. Physical laptop/phone/tablet and full-city performance remain unmeasured.
